name: @geoquery/rust
//: Façade so turbo can see the Rust workspace as one node in the repo-wide task graph. It carries no dependencies of its own — Cargo owns those. Every script `cd ..` first because the Cargo workspace root is the repository root (crates/ has no Cargo.toml), and cargo-deny in particular reads Cargo.toml/deny.toml from the directory it runs in. The commands are the ones that used to be pixi's *-rs tasks, verbatim; `--workspace` is load-bearing because the root Cargo.toml is a package as well as the workspace root.

scripts.test: cd .. && cargo nextest run --workspace && cargo test --doc --workspace
scripts.lint: cd .. && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo deny --workspace --locked check bans licenses sources
